name: io.github.aantenore/lorebase-herald
title: Lorebase
description: Read and change a governed, versioned knowledge graph on Postgres through typed tools.

environmentVariables.name: LOREBASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the Keeper REST API, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080

environmentVariables.name: LOREBASE_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Domain used when a tool call names none

environmentVariables.name: LOREBASE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of the agent's service principal; not needed when Keeper runs with authentication off
